config.errors.deadletterqueue.topic.name: connector.errors
config.neo4j.topic.cypher.cpg.edges: CALL { WITH event WITH event WHERE event.event_type = 'EDGE_UPSERT' MERGE (src:CPGNode {id: event.edge.source_id}) ON CREATE SET src.placeholder = true, src.file_id = event.file_id MERGE (dst:CPGNode {id: event.edge.target_id}) ON CREATE SET dst.placeholder = true, dst.file_id = event.file_id MERGE (src)-[r:CPG_EDGE {edge_id: event.edge.edge_id}]->(dst) SET r += CASE WHEN r.content_hash IS NULL OR r.content_hash <> event.content_hash THEN event.edge.properties ELSE {} END, r.edge_type = CASE WHEN r.content_hash IS NULL OR r.content_hash <> event.content_hash THEN event.edge.edge_type ELSE r.edge_type END, r.repository_id = CASE WHEN r.content_hash IS NULL OR r.content_hash <> event.content_hash THEN event.repository_id ELSE r.repository_id END, r.file_id = CASE WHEN r.content_hash IS NULL OR r.content_hash <> event.content_hash THEN event.file_id ELSE r.file_id END, r.parser_version = CASE WHEN r.content_hash IS NULL OR r.content_hash <> event.content_hash THEN event.parser_version ELSE r.parser_version END, r.schema_version = CASE WHEN r.content_hash IS NULL OR r.content_hash <> event.content_hash THEN event.schema_version ELSE r.schema_version END, r.content_hash = CASE WHEN r.content_hash IS NULL OR r.content_hash <> event.content_hash THEN event.content_hash ELSE r.content_hash END } CALL { WITH event WITH event WHERE event.event_type = 'EDGE_DELETE' MATCH ()-[r:CPG_EDGE {edge_id: event.edge.edge_id}]->() WHERE r.content_hash = event.content_hash DELETE r }
